questions.q: In the Blue Harbor Manufacturing example, what caused the warehouse to sell inventory that was already promised to another customer?
options: A bug in the ERP system
Disconnected spreadsheets that weren't updated in time
Too many employees using the same system
The customer canceled their order
questions.explain: Before ERP, sales and the warehouse each kept their own spreadsheet, so inventory promises made in one weren't reflected in the other in time.

questions.q: Who typically owns the overall accuracy of a company's financial statements and the close process?
options: The warehouse manager
The Controller
The Procurement buyer
External customers
questions.explain: The Controller is accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements and the integrity of the close process, typically managing AP, AR, and GL teams.

questions.q: What is 'master data' in the context of ERP integration?
options: The transaction history for the current fiscal year only
Shared reference records, like a supplier or customer, used consistently across modules
A password-protected administrative module
Data that only IT staff are allowed to view
questions.explain: Master data (suppliers, customers, employees, and similar records) is shared across modules so each one doesn't keep its own out-of-sync copy.

questions.q: In the Procure-to-Pay process, what comes immediately after the Purchase Order?
options: Receipt
Payment
Requisition
General Ledger posting
questions.explain: The order is Requisition, Purchase Order, Receipt, Invoice, Payment — the Receipt confirms the goods physically arrived.

questions.q: What is the naming convention for Oracle Fusion Cloud's quarterly releases?
options: The last two digits of the year plus a letter A through D for the quarter, such as 26A or 26C
Version numbers like 1.0, 2.0, 3.0
Random codenames chosen each quarter
The customer's own internal project name
questions.explain: Releases are named with the last two digits of the calendar year plus A, B, C, or D for which quarter it is — for example, 26A is the first release of 2026.

questions.q: What is Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications?
options: Oracle's modern, multi-tenant SaaS suite of business applications built on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
A single on-premises accounting program
A free add-on to Oracle E-Business Suite
A reporting tool that only works with non-Oracle databases
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications is Oracle's modern, multi-tenant SaaS suite, built from the ground up on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

options: Oracle's mature, on-premises (or customer-hosted) ERP suite, first released in the late 1990s
A reporting add-on for Fusion Cloud
A new product Oracle launched in 2026
A free trial version of Oracle Fusion Cloud
questions.explain: EBS is Oracle's mature on-premises ERP suite, first released in the late 1990s, and still widely used by enterprises today.

questions.q: Which of these responsibilities belongs to Oracle, not the customer, in the Fusion Cloud SaaS model?
options: Deciding Chart of Accounts structure
Patching the operating system and database
Assigning security roles to employees
Training AP clerks on the new process
questions.explain: Oracle manages the data center, operating system, database, the application itself, and its updates — the customer handles setup, security, data, and training.

questions.q: What does 'simplified UI' refer to in Oracle Fusion Cloud?
options: A paid add-on feature
Oracle's modern, click-driven interface design, built with fewer fields visible at once compared to older dense forms
A version of Fusion Cloud with fewer modules
A simplified pricing plan
questions.explain: Simplified UI describes the modern, guided, click-driven design Oracle built Fusion Cloud around, in contrast to older dense-form software like E-Business Suite.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what should be the first troubleshooting step when a user says 'my report never showed up'?
options: Check the Scheduled Processes work area for that job's status and log
Immediately assume the whole application is broken
Restart the user's computer
Submit a new quarterly update request
questions.explain: Checking the job's status and log in Scheduled Processes is almost always the first step — the issue is often a status like Error or Pending, not a broken application.

questions.q: What is the 'springboard' on the Oracle Fusion home page?
options: The notifications bell in the global header
The quarterly update readiness document
A security setting controlling password complexity
The grid of icons on the home page that shortcut into a user's accessible work areas
questions.explain: The springboard is the grid of work-area shortcut icons on the home page, giving a user one-click access to their most frequent starting points.

questions.q: What is a 'work area' in Oracle Fusion Cloud?
options: Just a label on a menu item with no further content
A dedicated landing page for one specific function, such as General Accounting
A type of security role
A folder on the user's desktop
questions.explain: A work area is a full landing page scoped to one function, often including a Tasks panel, infolets, and a worklist — more than just a menu label.

questions.q: Roughly how is the Oracle Fusion practice environment access sold, as last verified by this course?
options: A one-time lifetime purchase with no time limit
Approximately $85 for three months of access
Free, with a paid upgrade option
Billed per transaction entered in the system
questions.explain: As last verified, access runs approximately $85 for three months — a fixed window, which is why activation timing matters so much.

questions.q: According to the lesson, is the line between functional and technical consultants perfectly rigid in practice?
options: Yes, functional and technical consultants never overlap in skills
No, because functional consultants are technically not allowed in Setup and Maintenance
Yes, Oracle legally prohibits consultants from doing both
No — many functional consultants pick up data-load and API knowledge, and many technical consultants develop process judgment, and the gap keeps narrowing with low-code tools
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly notes the roles blur in practice, and that gap has narrowed further as Oracle invests in low-code extension tools.

questions.q: In the example 'Manage Payment Terms' inside Payables inside Financials, what level of the hierarchy is 'Payables'?
options: Offering
Task
Functional Area
Implementation project
questions.explain: Payables is a Functional Area — a grouping of related configuration within the broader Financials Offering.

options: A financial audit of the company's cash position
A test of how well the user interface fits different screen sizes
Comparing what the company needs against what the standard system does out of the box, to identify gaps
A review of Oracle's quarterly update readiness notes
questions.explain: Fit-gap analysis compares business requirements ('fit') against standard system capability, identifying gaps that need configuration, process change, or extension.
